description: Very expressive multilingual TTS (80+ languages) for drama and long-form reading; tops the open-weights leaderboards. Type free-form [tags] in a segment's text to steer the delivery: [sighs], [laughs], [whispering], [slow, dangerously quiet]. Clones from a reference clip plus its transcript. A 35B model split over several GPUs with GPU count: about 43 GB (two 24 GB GPUs), or 29 GB with 4-bit experts (two 16 GB, three 12 GB). Free under US$500k annual revenue (Fish Audio Community License).

workerSettings.label: Expert precision
workerSettings.description: 4-bit re-quantizes the model's experts while loading: about 29 GB instead of 43, so it fits on smaller GPUs (two 16 GB with the codec on the CPU, three 12 GB). Some loss of quality; loading takes a little longer.

workerSettings.label: Codec on the CPU
workerSettings.description: Encode reference clips and decode audio on the CPU: about 2 GB more room on the GPUs, a few seconds slower per segment. Without it the codec still falls back to the CPU when a GPU runs out of memory.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: The exact words spoken in the reference clip. Required for cloning. Without a reference clip the model invents a different voice for every segment.
